title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and varied diet is crucial to ensure the health of both mother and baby. However, choosing the right foods can be a challenge, especially when exploring international cuisine. In this article, we will introduce some international pantry staples that are good for pregnant women, helping you build a balanced and diverse diet.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
Here are some international pantry staples that are good for pregnant women:
* Oats: Oats are a rich source of fiber and iron, supporting digestive health and preventing anemia.
* Greek Yogurt: Greek yogurt is high in calcium and protein, supporting bone health and fetal development.
* Lentils: Lentils are a rich source of fiber, iron, and protein, supporting digestive health and preventing anemia.
* Low-Mercury Salmon: Salmon is a rich source of omega-3 fatty acids, supporting brain health and fetal development. However, it's essential to choose low-mercury salmon to ensure safety.
* Eggs: Eggs are a rich source of protein and vitamins, supporting overall health and fetal development.
* Leafy Greens and Citrus: Leafy greens and citrus are rich in vitamins and minerals, supporting overall health and preventing diseases.

## Building Balanced Plates
To build a balanced and diverse diet, you can combine these international pantry staples into your daily meals. Here are some suggestions:
* Breakfast: Oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fruit.
* Lunch: Lentils with leafy greens and citrus.
* Dinner: Low-mercury salmon with eggs and leafy greens.

## Food Safety Considerations
When pregnant, food safety is crucial. Here are some considerations:
* Choose fresh and clean foods.
* Cook foods before eating.
* Avoid eating foods that can cause food poisoning, such as sushi and sashimi.
* Consult with your doctor or a registered dietitian to ensure a safe and balanced diet.

## Conclusion
Eating a balanced and varied diet is essential during pregnancy. With these international pantry staples, you can build a diverse and nutritious diet. Remember to prioritize food safety and consult with your doctor or a registered dietitian to ensure a safe and balanced diet.
